AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Constructing Water Retention Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Selected Crop Management Practises? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Selected Crop Management Practises.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Selected Crop Management Practises.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Selected Crop Management Practises.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Selected Crop Management Practises.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Trees.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Trees.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Trees.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products.

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

16. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Constructing Framed Suspended Garden and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Adding Value to Crop Produce 8 4.4 Making Homemade Soap 8 Total Number of Lesson and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Adding Value to Crop Produce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Making Homemade Soap 8 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The suggested number of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Making Homemade Soap and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Controlling Soil Pollution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
